indicators.title: Global Food Price Index
indicators.context: The IMF's global food commodity price index — the upstream driver of grocery inflation.
indicators.read: Food costs have surged 30% over the past year — acute pressure on households.

indicators.title: Copper · “Dr. Copper”
indicators.context: The global price of copper ($/metric ton) — nicknamed “Dr. Copper” for its knack of signalling the direction of the global economy.
indicators.read: Copper is up 41% from a year ago, now 13,484.

indicators.title: Broad Commodity Index
indicators.context: The IMF's all-commodity price index — a single gauge of raw-input cost pressure across the economy.
indicators.read: Commodities is little changed from a year ago, now 167.
